name: ocr97_night_4_stress_mixed
description: Night 4: Stress test — combines the hardest document types from all three prior nights plus new cases. USCIS I-9 (multi-page government form with instructions), a second BIS Quarterly (original failing doc, now with full GB10 stack), the IRS 1040 schedule cross-reference (most complex IRS form), and a mixed corpus re-run of the original 3-document baseline to verify regression. Goal is to confirm that previous 72-score gap on BIS quarterly closes when routing is correct.

documents.title: USCIS Form I-9 — Employment Eligibility Verification
documents.goal: Extract a government eligibility form with employee attestation section, employer certification section, List A/B/C document type checkboxes, and dense instruction pages. Tests multi-section form OCR with checkbox fields and legal certification language.

documents.title: BIS Quarterly Review, December 2024 — REGRESSION CHECK
documents.goal: Re-run the BIS Quarterly Review December 2024 — the document that scored 72.07 when rapidocr was selected as fallback. This run validates whether the ensemble now routes to qwen3-vl:32b when GB10 is available, closing the gap to the 90+ floor. Extract chart-adjacent text, market terminology, and quantitative financial language.

documents.title: IRS Schedule B (2024) — Interest and Ordinary Dividends
documents.goal: Extract a tabular financial form listing payers of interest and dividends with amounts, Part III foreign account questions, and summary lines. Tests narrow-column table parsing and foreign account checkbox logic.

documents.title: Federal Reserve Financial Stability Report, November 2024 — BASELINE RERUN
documents.goal: Re-run the original baseline document (scored 94.08 in May benchmark) to confirm no regression. Extract text, tables, numeric risk language, and section headings.
